_comment_about_this_file: Claude Code PLUGIN manifest for kanbanr (roadmap FEAT-023).
It bundles kanbanr's Claude integration — the SKILL.md behavioral contract
plus the SessionStart/Stop enforcement hooks — so that, once installed via
a marketplace, a user gets the skill + hooks together in one step.
VERIFY-AGAINST-DOCS (fields used here, per code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins
and /en/plugins-reference#plugin-manifest-schema, current as of 2026-06):
- name (required): the plugin id + skill namespace (kebab-case).
- description, version, author, homepage, repository, license, keywords:
standard metadata.
- skills (string|array): CUSTOM paths to directories that CONTAIN a
<name>/SKILL.md. kanbanr's skill lives at the repo's `skill/kanbanr/`
(note: singular `skill/`, NOT the default `skills/`), so we point at
`${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skill` and Claude Code discovers `skill/kanbanr/SKILL.md`.
- hooks (object|string): inline hook config (used here) OR a path to a
hooks file. Hook `command` paths MUST use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} so they
resolve inside the installed/cached plugin dir (NEVER hardcode absolute
paths like /home/you/...). ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} expands to this plugin's
root directory at runtime.
NOTE on `_comment*` keys: real plugin.json is strict JSON and ignores
unknown keys; these are explanatory only and safe to strip.
name: kanbanr
description: kanbanr — the project-management system of record for Claude-driven development. Bundles the kanbanr skill (recover/scope/plan/track work via the git-backed kanbanr CLI) with SessionStart + Stop enforcement hooks. Requires the `kanbanr` binary on PATH (ships separately via crates.io / GitHub Releases).
_comment_skills: `skills` field lists directories that contain `<name>/SKILL.md`, so we give
the parent `skill` dir. VERIFY: if a future Claude Code requires the default
`skills/` layout, either rename the dir or keep this explicit path.
_comment_hooks: Two enforcement hooks (roadmap FEAT-017) plus the session-summary hook
(FEAT-101: PostCompact, SessionEnd and a SessionStart sweep; bash + python,
so not on Windows), registered inline here using
${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}-relative commands so they work after the plugin is
copied to the cache. These mirror skill/kanbanr/hooks/settings.snippet.json
but WITHOUT the hardcoded absolute paths.
Cross-platform: Linux/macOS run the .sh scripts (type:command). Windows users
should run the .ps1 equivalents — see skill/kanbanr/hooks/README.md. If you
need a single manifest to serve both OSes, swap the command for the matching
.ps1 with a PowerShell invocation; we default to .sh here since that is the
